title: A Higgsfield-only ask that picks the fast lane may use it, without a Slate production
why: The fast lane is used when someone picks it. Here the requester picks it up front, with no brand involved, so the agent should take it rather than ask again or start a film.
prompt: Quick generated clip please, not a full production: eight seconds of rain running down a window at night.

expect.why: no film folder for a picked quick clip

notes: The fast lane can't spend during an eval: Higgsfield's app credits aren't funded, Claude Code's run denies the higgsfield CLI, and Slate's Cloud API calls stay in replay. Loading the fast-lane skill or trying the CLI is what counts as using it.
